posts.name: Matchstickman
posts.cooked:
If you weren't designing games professionally, what would you be doing? Do you think you would have some other creative outlet?

Where do you see >G going? Can you imagine it getting Asmodee big?

The Sentinels card game is ending. Are you happy that you get to share a whole story with everyone else or sad that you're on longer going to be telling this story in this form?

Spirit Island is someone else's game, how much input into the story behind the game did >G have? Do you think the story has as big a connection to the game as Sentinels does?

When are you next coming to England?

posts.cooked: There is a ton of backstory to Sentinels of the Multiverse. It comes through in the bios, flavor text, and the stories to the expansions. But I am wondering, looking back on Sentinels of the Multiverse, how much of the backstory and so on Christopher thought was really essential to the game and how much was just extra stuff for his own amusement. (I like building a world as much as anybody, but often lots of it gets dropped on the floor!)
